description:
Make every little detail count with custom tissue paper.

Finishing touches matter, especially if you want to elevate the unboxing experience of your customers. Custom printed and blank tissue paper can help you do just that — not only does it protect your products from dirt and impact, but it also makes a good first impression on people.   

Premium Presentation in Different Sizes and Materials

Custom printed and blank tissue paper make your products look even more professional and polished. Plus, they protect items from dirt and cushion them from damage especially during transit. 

Custom Printed Tissue Sizes 

  • 10” x 14" 
  • 14” x 20” 
  • 18” x 24” 
  • 21" x 29"

The 14” x 20” and 18” x 24” sizes come half-folded and all are available in these two paper types: 
    • 10 lb. paper – Soft and elegant, this paper is ideal to use in retail for wrapping products or for lining gift boxes.   
    • 18 lb. paper – Thicker and more durable, this paper is slightly heavier than wrapping paper. Available in 21” x 29” only.  

Blank Tissue Paper Sizes 

Our blank tissue paper also comes in various sizes to fit into our mailer, product, and shipping boxes.

If you need blank tissue paper for boxes with sizes not mentioned on the list above, or if you want to wrap bulky products, we have 20” x 30” and 20” x 15” all-purpose sizes.   

 When you order blank or unprinted tissue paper, it is packaged using the soft fold method, meaning up to 500 sheets are stacked and folded into a bundle. Next, this bundle is shrink-wrapped for easy storage. 

 For small quantity orders, we’ll ship them with protective tissue placed on the bottom and top, and for bulk orders, we’ll use corrugated cardboard for protection.  

 You’ll receive your unprinted tissue paper neatly packed and ready for bulk storage.  

(Note: The soft fold packaging method only applies to blank or unprinted tissue paper.) 

 Paper Colors  

 Our tissue paper is available in eight different colors:  

  • White 
  • Black 
  • Brown Kraft 
  • Red 
  • Hot Pink 
  • Dark Green 
  • Blue Breeze 
  • Lilac 

Chic and Fun Packaging Made Easy

Make unwrapping packages enjoyable for customers. Our premium tissue paper makes packaging chic and fun, and they help your brand become even more memorable.  

How can you use tissue paper for your business? Here are some ideas:  

  • Event styling – Great for wrapping marketing swag or banquet favors 
  • Party décor – Use tissue paper to spruce up any room for a party 
  • Gift box or shopping bag inserts – Cushion fragile items and line gift bags 
  • Personalized gift wraps – Cover gifts that you send out to clients  

Add your logo to the tissue paper or choose a color that meets your brand aesthetic. This can help increase the perceived value of your product from budget to premium.  

For added protection and cushioning effect, consider combining blank tissue paper with a branded one for your packaging.
